prompt:
Pixel art background for a 2D side-scrolling game, 16-bit style with crisp square pixels and a limited palette, wide straight-on front view, no perspective tilt. The bottom third of the image is an empty flat floor completely clear of objects, so sprites can stand on it. No people, no characters, no text, no letters, no logos, no readable signs, nothing blurry.
Scene: a bright retro arcade hall at noon. Big windows on the back wall pour in warm sunlight with soft pink and sky-blue tints; a row of pastel arcade cabinets with glowing screens along the wall, a potted plant, a wall clock, light cream walls. Floor: pale checkered tiles with a thin pink guide line. Cheerful daytime mood, warm palette.
